# Firebase Web SDK (vendored)

- Version: **10.14.1**
- Build: compat (`firebase-app-compat.js`, `firebase-auth-compat.js`)
- Source: https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.14.1/
- License: Apache License 2.0 (Firebase JS SDK)

These files are vendored so the auth pages work without a CDN dependency. Update the version in `login.html`, `forgot-password.html`, and `reset-password.html` if you upgrade.

Only Authentication is included. Firestore/Cloud Functions SDKs will be added when the data layer is implemented.
